title: A Game I'm Continuously Updating Through Vibe Coding
author: New_Consequence3669
selftext:
I've been working on this mobile game for quite some time now.

I first released it around May of this year. Back then, I developed it using Claude, but the current version is being developed with Codex.

It's a collection of mini-games, and with each update, I remove games that aren't particularly fun and replace them with new ones.

My current development workflow uses an LLM-based system where Codex handles planning, design, and code reviews, while a local AI model handles coding and modifications through Unity MCP.

The main goal of this setup is to reduce token consumption. According to Codex's evaluation, my local AI model's coding ability is fairly decent.

Recently, I came across an article claiming that simply modifying model weights could improve mathematical reasoning. That made me curious whether I could improve my local model's coding ability in a similar way, so I ran a few experiments. Unfortunately, those attempts weren't successful.

Anyway, putting all the technical stuff aside, the game itself is a casual collection of mini-games designed to be enjoyed in short sessions of about five minutes.

I'd really appreciate it if you could give it a try whenever you have a few minutes!

Thank you for your time and support!
